name: ActiveCampaign
category: Email marketing automation and light CRM
oneLiner: Email marketing automation with a built-in CRM. Starter/Plus/Pro/Enterprise pricing scales with contact-list size; the public pricing page bills annually only.
summary: ActiveCampaign is email marketing automation software with a built-in CRM, sold across four plans (Starter, Plus, Pro, Enterprise) whose price rises with the number of contacts on the account. Its public pricing page shows only the annual-billing, monthly-equivalent rate; sales-pipeline add-ons (Pipelines, Sales Engagement), SMS credits and extra user seats all exist but are not priced anywhere public.
notFor: Buyers who need a genuinely free tool under 1,000 contacts — ActiveCampaign has no permanent free plan, only a 14-day trial.
pros: Every paid plan, including Starter, includes marketing automation and a CRM, not just the top tier
No setup or onboarding fee on any plan, per ActiveCampaign's own pricing FAQ
14-day free trial with no credit card required, running on Professional-plan features
1,000+ native integrations, including Shopify, WooCommerce, Salesforce and Stripe
cons: No permanent free plan, only a 14-day trial
Starter tops out at 25,000 contacts and 1 user seat (plus at most 1 purchasable extra seat)
Sales-pipeline add-ons (Pipelines, Sales Engagement), SMS credits, Custom Reports and extra user seats all exist but have no published price — visible only after signing up
Price rises steeply with contacts: Enterprise runs from $145/month at 1,000 contacts to $1,169/month at 50,000 contacts, billed annually
Public pricing page shows annual-billing rates only; ActiveCampaign's own billing-help article confirms a Monthly cadence exists, but its rate is never published
